# Free Online Silence Remover

Remove silence, dead air and awkward gaps from any audio in seconds. See the waveform before and after, listen to both versions, then download. No signup and your files never leave your device.

## How it works

1. Upload: Drop one or many audio files. MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG and FLAC work in most browsers.
2. Tune: Pick a preset or set the threshold, minimum silence and edge padding yourself.
3. Remove: One click cuts every silent gap that matches your settings, right in your browser.
4. Download: Compare original and result, then save as WAV or MP3.

## Features [...] ### Is my audio uploaded anywhere?

No. Decoding, detection, cutting and encoding all happen inside your browser tab. Closing the tab removes the data from memory.

### Which formats can I upload and download?

You can upload any audio format your browser can decode, which usually includes MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG and FLAC. Downloads are WAV (lossless) or MP3 (128 kbps).

### Is it free?

Yes. There is no sign-up, no watermark and no daily limit. The site is supported by ads.

### Is the spelling silence or silance?

The correct spelling is silence. People often search for silance remover or silence zap, and this page covers all of them. [...] ## Who uses a silence remover?

Podcasters use it to tighten episodes, YouTubers to clean narration before editing, teachers and students to shorten recorded lectures, and anyone who receives long voice messages to make them quicker to listen to. Creators who build videos from AI voices use it to remove the gaps that generated speech leaves between sentences.

## Why browser-based processing matters

Many online audio tools upload your file to a server. SilenceZap does not. Your browser decodes the audio, the tool analyses and cuts it locally, and the result is created on your device. That makes it faster for large files, works without an account, and keeps private recordings private.
